object.name: base
object.prompt:
Animate this Meteor Storm effect as one continuous pixel-art RPG VFX.

Multiple flaming meteors rapidly fall from the upper sky . Each meteor enters from above at a steep diagonal angle with a short bright fire trail, strikes with a sharp explosive impact, then another meteor lands at a slightly different position inside the same target area. Overlapping impacts create bursts of fire, sparks, glowing debris, smoke.

IMPORTANT:
Keep the target area locked in exactly the same position for the entire animation.
Keep the same camera angle, perspective, canvas size, scale, and ground plane.
Meteors must clearly travel downward before impact — do not make them suddenly appear on the ground.
Impacts should occur sequentially and overlap naturally, creating a chaotic meteor shower.
Do not turn the effect into one giant explosion.
Do not create multiple examples, a contact sheet, separate variations, or numbered frames.
Do not add a character, weapon, text, UI, scenery, or background.

True handcrafted pixel art, crisp hard pixels, transparent background, no blur, no anti-aliasing.
Bright white-yellow meteor cores, orange-red flames, dark ember fragments, sparks and smoke.
Powerful magical fire attack designed for an isometric fantasy RPG.

JUST ONLY COMET NO GROUND IN THIS FX
